items.note: S1.1 names the copy/gather/scatter/side-injection gates, the forward-inverse-forward stages, the exchange 'up to a sign' and the scratch restoration, but it gives neither h=100, the triple indexing, N or m, nor the explicit map (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a). The net-change identity (JV+RG)x=x is not shown.

The mechanism is right: a common frame commutes with a pointwise linear gate. But S1.2 says only 'D_out D_in^{-1}' remains, leaving out the scalar network S_Omega and the route sign epsilon_w. The paper's operator is D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1}, and a route applies epsilon_w D_sink(rho(w)) D_source(w)^{-1}.

The plan has the indicator-vector form, nested labels, the single decreasing edge (center 3->4, loss h), L=Ich, Wm-2N+2L and L_b/N=100/539, with telescoping and the 2L count shown as in the paper. The actual labels (terminal table, eq:motif-labels, residual table) and L_c/N=101/539 are missing, so nestedness is asserted rather than verified.

Both the rank-equals-dimension argument and the N rank-one source exceptions giving s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b<W_b m follow the paper, and S1.5.3 uses M_out(rho(w))-M_in(w)=I_m. The endpoint computation P_{U_a^perp}+P_{U_a}=I_m is never shown, and the -P_{U_a} source assignment appears only as 'negative source projections'.

S2.1 gets the kernels right (one aI+bX_v per orthonormal residual vector) and the C^{tensor m} endpoint after corrections. It omits the phase frames C_U=H diag(i^{q_U}) H and gives only 's<Wm' in place of s_c=W_c m-2N+2L_c.

For the bit network the chain L_b/N<1/2 => deficit N-2L>0 => (relative deficit >20*2^-50, log m<20) => s/W<m^tau, tau=1-2^-50 is the paper's route. The exact deficits eta_b, eta_c are not given, and the complex counterpart (L_c/N, s_c/W_c<m^sigma) appears only as 's<Wm' and 'a<=m^sigma'.
'The elementary stream operation' and 'linear-time controlled updates' are invoked without the operations or the controlled-shift lemma being stated.

The plan gives A=E_1 Pi E_2, the order of the transforms around Pi D, and one interchange per pivot via two controlled updates, all as in 1432-1443. The elimination proof of the factorization (1375-1392) and the choice of the fixed prime q are absent.

Every step of the proof is here: k=0 base, cyclic row split into W role streams of volume V/W, Phi_{A_e} edges by recursive pivot interchanges, the endpoint identity giving H<-H+D, the three-update interchange, s calls, recurrence, geometric sum in both cases, and the fixed-tape parking schedule.
The plan follows 1649-1734: high digits as rows, padding to R'<2R, base-m pieces with a geometric sum, and padding binary ranges to [q^e].

The plan has s_c child calls on f=e/m axes, no extra calls from inverse wrappers, row-addition decomposition of GL(m,F_2) and H_0^{tensor D}=b^D S_D C^{tensor D} S_D. Two things are missing: conjugation by P_M, which puts the residual directions on coordinate slots (eq:phase-edge-coordinate), and the inverse-child formula (C^{-1})^{tensor f}=(-i)^f Z C Z.

The time bound with delta_bad, the eight rotations correct off a small address set, and the deterministic repair by sorting all match. Several pieces are missing: the third chunk z used as restored scratch, the guard-value interval defining the bad set, and the fact that T_0 S_0^{-1} permutes only that set.

Recurrence, internal-node sum O(e^lambda), leaf bound and base-m pieces follow 2393-2448. The plan never says where the rows come from (the first q_0 chunks taken as a row index and padded to a multiple of W^{k_0}), and S2.6.5 uses q_0 undefined. The node overhead O((eK)^tau+1) is not tied to the packed lemma.

The statement (D<=d chunks, O(Vd^{lambda'}), one final truncation, error <sqrt2 2^-p) and the main proof route are right. The guard width Delta=ceil(C_0 d^{C_1}) is only asserted: the arithmetic-depth recurrence A(e)<=sA(e/m)+E behind it is absent.

The plan follows the paper throughout: character cancellation by the shift k->k+t/2^{v+1}, DIF step, bit-reversed storage, the reverse procedure giving F^+B^{-1}, grouped rounds, prefix-slot moves and chunk exchanges, and the three-term cost.
The plan matches 3233-3367: evaluation at B_0=2^{4p}, the |h_j|<B_0/2 separation, signed carries, centered-residue extraction and four products.
The plan has the retained LB order (motivated by permutations commuting with pointwise products), the normalization identity and the M(3delta+eta) error, all as in the proof.

The route (T P_s F_s = P_t F_t S, the Neumann inverse of N=CTD, A=S', B_0=D'J'C) and the tensor form with gamma=2d alpha^2 are faithful. The statement drops the hypothesis theta=t/s-1>p/alpha^4 and the <p^2 error of the approximations.
The plan follows the proof: chirp periodicity, the coefficient check, F_q^+R_c=R_c^{-1}F_q^+, permutations commuting with pointwise products, and the double normalization giving (u*v)/S^2.
Fixed values, sizes, alpha, the prime interval and T/2<S<T are all correct. The prime-existence count, eta=1/(4d) and the check alpha^4 theta_i>p are asserted rather than derived.
The plan follows the paper: the isomorphism, the triangular mixed-radix formula, prefix-controlled cyclic shifts and the O(d^2) axis reversal.

The isomorphism and the wrap check match 4303-4319. Missing are the interface formula M_C(f,g)=D_- iota^{-1} M_r(iota D_+ f, iota D_+ g)=(f*g)/T and the computed version's error (pack lines 4349-4413).
The source-transform composition and all six steps are as in the paper, including the two occurrences of S.
The plan follows the paper's chain E_ring -> E_s -> E_w -> final error <1/2, then rounding and the carry recurrence. The chirp <8TL step is folded into E_s.

min g_i=2^-181=2kappa from the chunk-exchange term, the log-power absorption and the final bound are right. Only three of the seven table rows are listed; CRT/axis layouts, Gaussian line maps, chirps and packed products are missing.
S0 says the bound disproves the n log n conjecture in this model but gives no lower-bound/liminf content.

errors.says: Along a route only the endpoint operator D_out D_in^{-1} remains.
errors.paper: The implemented operator is D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1}; a route w->rho(w) applies epsilon_w D_sink(rho(w)) D_source(w)^{-1} (the scalar network and its sign stay).

errors.says: A length-s transform is obtained from a length-t transform for t>s with gcd(s,t)=1.
errors.paper: The lemma also requires theta=t/s-1>p/alpha^4 with 2<=alpha<sqrt p and p>100.

errors.says: Writing D-q_0 in base m ... gives total cost O(d^{lambda'}).
errors.paper: q_0=ceil(log_2 W) ceil(log_m(2d)) chunks are first consumed as a row index (2307-2323); the plan never introduces q_0 or that row construction.

chain: The tree reaches the main bound by the paper's route. It runs from the bit network, labels, rank budget and tau through matrix shears, the power-width recurrence and arbitrary widths to the phase network, simultaneous layer, synthetic transforms, resampling/chirp, parameters, error and cost. It thins out at the network's own definition (h, N, m and the explicit exchange are absent), at the complex phase interface (frames and the s_c formula are only named), at the row source for the layer recursion, and in the cost table, where four of the seven rows are missing.

steps.note: S1.1 names the gate types, the forward/backward/forward stages, the exchange 'up to a sign' and scratch restoration. It omits h=100, the triple indexing of X_a,Y_a, N=binom(h,3)^3, m=h^3 and the explicit map (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a).

The plan has the invertible frame per vertex, its commuting with a pointwise linear gate, the endpoint operator, and edges paying only the frame change (each edge an address shear). It is loose only in omitting S_Omega from D_out S D_in^{-1}.

The plan has subspaces of a fixed m-dimensional space built from tensor products of triple indicators, nondegenerate and orthogonal for neighbours, nested on every edge, with the only decreasing edges central 3->4 each losing h.
S1.3.4.1 has rank(P_V-P_U)=dim V-dim U for nested U subset V, and S1.3.4.2 the N rank-one source exceptions 2P_{U_a}.
The plan has sum |Delta dim|=Wm-2N+2L with L=Ich, and s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b.
S1.3.3 has L_b/N=100/539<1/2, and S1.3.4.3 the deficit N-2L_b>0, hence s<Wm. The complex ratio 101/539 is absent, but the bit chain is complete.
S1.5.3 has M_out(rho(w))-M_in(w)=I_m, giving H<-H+D on every role including scratch. The verification P_{U_a^perp}+P_{U_a}=I is not shown.
The plan has A=E_1 Pi E_2, exactly a interchanges plus O(V), and the edge shears making s recursive calls in total.
Children of volume V/W, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), tau=1-2^-50 from relative deficit >20*2^-50 and log m<20, and F_k=O(e^tau) are all present. The exact eta values are not given.

central.summary: Eight of nine steps are reconstructed. The plan carries the frames, labels, rank-equals-dimension, the budget Wm-2N+2L with L=Ich, L_b/N=100/539, the endpoint identity, the E_1 Pi E_2 shear cost and the recurrence to O(e^tau) with tau=1-2^-50. The one weak point is C1: the network is described by its gates and stages only, without h=100, the triple indexing, N, m or the explicit exchange (X,Y)->(-Y,X).
